info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Purchasables API

params.name: partID
params.description: The ID of the part you need purchasables for.

params.name: page
params.description: This parameter is used to paginate results based on the limit. Refer to Pagination section for more information.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

params.name: nameStartsWith
params.description: Filter purchasables that have a name which starts with this string.

items.docs:
This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve a part's purchasable data. The response of this request is documented as a JSON schema.

Return data description

| **Property** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| partID | The ID of the part the purchasable belongs to. |
| name | The name of the purchasable. |
| size | The size of the purchasable. |
| orderUnitCode | The unit that describes how this purchasable is ordered. E.g. "by the box", or "by the foot". |
